title: 七月回撤：资管老手，耐心才是长期关键
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: Will Proof has a very strong future tense connotation, and I think the temptation there would be the testing of the patients, because you give up some performance currently in the hope that that will pay off.
segments.zh: “将”这个词有很强的未来时含义，我认为那里的诱惑是对耐心的考验，因为你放弃了一些当前的表现，希望将来能得到回报。

segments.en: How strongly do you believe in patients, Christine, I guess, is my question. And how do you look at that from a convincing your clients, that is a good idea, perspective?
segments.zh: 我想问的是，你有多相信耐心？以及你如何从说服客户的角度来看待这是一个好主意？

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, the way we look at it would be how we think about consistency and returns over the longer term. I'm always like to position it from the perspective of being able to survive drawdowns.
segments.zh: 是的，我们看待它的方式是考虑长期的一致性和回报。我总是喜欢从能够承受回撤的角度来定位它。

segments.en: Again, July was a great example of many people who were very, very heavily into the tech trade being concerned about being able to survive these drawdowns.
segments.zh: 七月就是一个很好的例子，许多重仓科技的人担心能否承受这些回撤。

segments.en: And ultimately, when it comes to returns, the way that I would think about it would be, how do we manage to ensure that there is longevity and consistency in those returns.
segments.zh: 最终，关于回报，我的思考方式是，我们如何确保持久性和一致性。

segments.en: And ultimately, it comes back down to diversification of your exposure as well as being able to pick very stock specific angles that will be able to ride above a beta and generate alpha.
segments.zh: 最终，这归结为配置的多元化，以及能够挑选非常具体的个股角度，从而超越市场并获得超额收益。
